title: Resources landing rebuild
lede: The Guides home is now an editorial handbook index: a featured lead, type-grouped titles, one search row, and a tools strip. The old identical icon-card grid is gone.

sections.heading: Home
sections.note: Authenticated Preview, ADMIN Erik Role, dark appearance, Cursor Chromium. Before is the user-captured landing. After is the rebuilt index at 1920×1080. These are not hash-bound matched captures. Next.js issue overlay is HMR chrome.

shots.title: Icon-card grid
shots.cap: Featured was one more small card. Two search fields sat side by side. The SMB path competed with New guide in the header. Contacts and assignments were extra cards.

shots.title: Editorial index
shots.cap: Photo Mechanic is a large featured lead. Remaining guides group by How-to, Media Drive, and General. One search field plus compact ⌘K. Path, Contacts, and Assignments sit in a tools strip.

sections.heading: Related states
sections.note: Same Preview session. No matched befores for these states.

shots.title: List layout
shots.cap: List stacks titles under type headers. URL is ?layout=list. Featured lead stays.

shots.title: How-to filter
shots.cap: Jump chip sets filter=how-to. Chip, Clear all, and 3 of 5 guides count appear. Photo Mechanic returns to the filtered list.

shots.title: Contacts directory
shots.cap: filter=contacts still opens the live team directory with role/area/cleanup filters. Brand assets tab was smoke-checked separately.

changes.was: Featured was one more small icon card in a three-column grid.
changes.now: The first featured guide is a large title with a Featured · type kicker and an Open guide action.

changes.was: Every guide used the same muted book-icon card, so How-to and Media Drive looked identical.
changes.now: Guides group under How-to, Media Drive, and General with Gotham titles and hairline rows or two-column tiles.

changes.was: Header packed tabs, New guide, and the SMB path. Two search fields sat side by side.
changes.now: Header is title, section switcher, and New guide. One search field plus compact ⌘K. Jump chips for How-to, Media Drive, Contacts, and Assignments. Path and directories live in a tools strip.

verification: Home: featured lead, type groups, jump chips, tools strip, New guide, Guides/Brand assets switcher.
